'''Eknath Prabhakar Ghate''' is a [[mathematician]] specialising in [[number theory]] and working at the School of Mathematics, [[Tata Institute of Fundamental Research]], Mumbai, India. He was awarded the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize]] for science and technology, the highest science award in India, for the year 2013 in the mathematical sciences category.<ref>{{cite web|title=Dr. Samir K. Bramhachari Announces Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Award 2013|url=http://pib.nic.in/newsite/erelease.aspx?relid=99698|publisher=Press Information Bureau, Government of India|access-date=30 December 2013}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Ghate was schooled at [[Mayo College]], Ajmer and at the [[International School Manila]]. He studied at [[St. Stephen's College, Delhi]] and obtained his bachelor's degree from the College of Arts & Sciences, [[University of Pennsylvania]] in 1991.<ref>{{cite web|title=Eknath Ghate, C'91, Awarded the 2013 Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize|url=https://www.sas.upenn.edu/news/eknath-ghate-c91-awarded-2013-shanti-swarup-bhatnagar-prize|access-date=30 December 2013}}</ref> He earned his [[Ph.D.]] from the [[University of California, Los Angeles]], in 1996;<ref>{{cite web|last=Jyotishmaan Gogoi|title=Eknath Ghate wins the Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Award 2013|date=28 September 2013|url=http://gonitsora.com/eknath-ghate-wins-shanti-swarup-bhatnagar-award-2013/|publisher=Gonit Sora|access-date=30 December 2013}}</ref> his doctoral advisor was [[Haruzo Hida]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|36627}}</ref>

== Career ==
Ghate is a professor at the [[Tata Institute of Fundamental Research]]. In number theory, Ghate is mostly interested in problems connected to [[automorphic form]]s, [[Galois representation]]s, and the special values of [[L-function]]s.

== Awards ==
Ghate was awarded the [[Shanti Swaroop Bhatnagar Award|Bhatnagar Award]] in 2013. Ghate was elected a Fellow of the [[Indian Academy of Sciences]] in 2014. Ghate was awarded the [[Jack Gibson (schoolmaster)|JTM Gibson Award]] for Excellence by Mayo College in 2019. He was elected Fellow of the Indian National Science Academy in 2021.
